`abstract class FrameBufferHandle<T extends Texture>`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IFrameBuffer`](/reference/bridges/iframebuffer/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`GlFrameBuffer`](/reference/base-opengl/glframebuffer/), [`VulkanFrameBuffer`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanframebuffer/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.framebuffer` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [FrameBufferHandle.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/framebuffer/FrameBufferHandle.java)

The base class of a framebuffer, which owns its color texture and deletes it with its own handle.

- [Framebuffers](/build/writing-a-backend/#framebuffers)
- [Framebuffers and depth](/build/framebuffers-and-depth/)
